subtests.name: Reducing a select's size to 1 updates selectedcontent.
Removing a select's multiple attribute updates selectedcontent.
Removing an option's disabled attribute updates selectedcontent.
Removing an optgroup's disabled attribute updates selectedcontent.
Adding an option's selected attribute updates selectedcontent.
An attribute change that does not change selectedness does not update selectedcontent.
Removing a select's multiple attribute updates selectedcontent when selectedness does not change.
